action.command:
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.1.2 -c '
cd /opt/keycloak
found=""
for j in $(find . -name "*.jar" 2>/dev/null); do
  if unzip -l "$j" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "base/messages/messages_de.properties"; then
    found="$j"; break
  fi
done
echo "FOUND: $found"
if [ -n "$found" ]; then
  unzip -p "$found" org/keycloak/themes/keycloak/base/messages/messages_de.properties 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "specialchar|invalidPasswordLength|lowerCase|upperCase|digit" | head
  echo "--- en ---"
  unzip -p "$found" org/keycloak/themes/keycloak/base/messages/messages.properties 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "specialchar|invalidPasswordLength|lowerCase|upperCase|digit" | head
fi
' 2>&1
